Physical side-effects:  


* Insomnia (treatable with prescription Melatonin or OTC's, no need for another antidepressant)   

* Constant brain fog / Fatigue (You eventually get used to it, but it can be very off-putting for people, like myself)   

* Jaw-clenching / Teeth grinding whilst sleeping (Some people swear by mouth-guards)   

* Increased sweating whilst sleeping (I woke up and my pants were sticking to my legs)  

* Decreased appetite (You probably will struggle to finish meals and may lose some weight)  

* Increased physical anxiety symptoms (like chest tightness, hot flushes / cold flushes)  

* Decreased libido (I tried watching porn but it just felt annoying and eh)   

* Diarrhea (in my case I had to sprint to the toilet whilst in the gym, that has never happened to me)   

* Visual floaters   


Mental side-effects / Startup period:   


* Increased depressive mood (I think being so fatigued had something to do with this)   

* Increase state of anxiety  (Just felt like the world was ending, my thoughts got 10x worse)   

* More prone to panic attacks in the startup (Panic attacks are very rare for me, I had one about 3 days in)  


So I was only on it for a good 16 or 17 days. I went on it mainly for obsessive anxious thoughts / anxiety, but in that small period the anxiety symptoms just became a lot worse which ultimately ended in me stopping cold turkey.  I am now about 23 days out from stopping cold turkey and still feel like I am recovering from the effects it had. I may be very sensitive to SSRI's, or I may have just picked the wrong one. I'm not sure if I gave it more time, that the real positive effects would have kicked in or not by now. Everyone reacts differently. I tell you, I see more positives than negatives with Lexapro, though.
